name: Output Kit
tagline: Copy-paste templates for decks, reports, pages, motion and AI interfaces, all on one design system.
author: Frederik

categories.label: Decks
categories.blurb: 16:9 slides that scale with their container. Paste slides into the deck shell.

categories.label: Reports
categories.blurb: Blocks for memos, briefings and printable reports.

categories.label: Page sections
categories.blurb: Heroes, feature grids, pricing, FAQ and footers for HTML pages.

categories.label: Motion
categories.blurb: Animated numbers, charts, text and overlays in CSS and vanilla JS.

categories.label: Interactive
categories.blurb: Buttons, tabs, toggles, dialogs, toasts and other controls.

categories.label: Data viz
categories.blurb: Dependency-free SVG charts that read their colours from the series tokens.

categories.label: AI interfaces
categories.blurb: Chat threads, prompt composers, streaming answers and tool calls.
